### ADDITIONS

![Maplemeéleel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8f95f4ddac124a280de566fb501f8b2fed51550.png)

The LONG-AWAITED, AWARD-WINNING AND JAW-DROPPING "BIOMES YOU DESERVE" HAS RELEASED 

This mod adds 2 new biomes in the overworld, the **Dark Taiga** and the **Maple Forest**

The **Dark Taiga** adds a new black wood set and a new hostile mob called the darkeer, which can multiply into tiny versions of itself when it hits another entity.

And now the **Maple Forest**... uuuuh... so.... i will probably change it drastically in the future because of the new drop (damn you mojang.....)

Lets get to the point. **The Maple Forest** is a cozy biome with warm colors that adds a new wood set with a color between oak and spruce, and also now you can craft a maple tap with two iron ingots and place it on a maple log to make it produce maple sap, to harvest it you will ned to place a cauldron below the maple tap, and when it fills up right click it with an empty bottle to collect it, then if you want to convert it into maple syrup, you may need to use a funace to do so :)

This mod also adds new stuff to the flower forest!

**Malus Trees** can now appear in the biome and you can use the new green apples that the trees produce to make copper green apples that grant you a new potion effect called knockback Resistance

thats it.

thats the mod.

Ill probably make some bug fixes.

Ill probably port it to 1.21.1.

maybe i add more things, maybe i add a new cave biome

but yeah.

thats the mod.![Maple stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8f95f4ddac124a280de566fb501f8b2fed51550.png)
